mapper.select: select * from px_workspace_qa where owner_id=#{owner} and request_id=#{id}
select request_id,status,coverage,input_chars,output_chars,elapsed_ms,target_type,target_id,create_time from px_workspace_qa where owner_id=#{owner} order by create_time desc,request_id desc limit 50
mapper.update: update px_workspace_qa set status='timeout' where owner_id=#{owner} and status='running' and create_time < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-180,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: select count(*) from px_workspace_qa where owner_id=#{owner} and status='running'
mapper.update: update px_workspace_qa set status=case when status='cancelled' then 'cancelled' else #{status} end,answer=#{answer},sources_json=#{sourcesJson},coverage=#{coverage},output_chars=#{outputChars},elapsed_ms=#{elapsedMs} where owner_id=#{ownerId} and request_id=#{requestId} and (status='running' or (status='cancelled' and #{status}='failed'))
update px_workspace_qa set status='cancelled' where owner_id=#{owner} and request_id=#{id} and status='running'
update px_workspace_qa set status='applied',target_type=#{targetType},target_id=#{targetId} where owner_id=#{ownerId} and request_id=#{requestId} and status='done'
